entries.en: Dummy

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Rejoice, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We're adding another fusion type to[n]make sure a "fool" like you won't fail[n]in his rehabilitation.
entries.uk: Ми додаємо ще один вид злиття,[n]щоб такий «блазень», як ти, не[n]провалив свою реабілітацію.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It's called Guillotine Search.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Instead of the normal method, you select[n]your desired Persona first, then learn[n]which to sacrifice...
entries.uk: На відміну від звичайного способу,[n]ти спершу обираєш бажану Персону,[n]а тоді дізнаєшся, кого жертвувати...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Please rely on this fusion type if you[n]feel it will be beneficial to you.
entries.uk: Будь ласка, користуйся цим видом[n]злиття, якщо вважатимеш його[n]корисним.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You better be thankful, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We'll explain fusion in a way even[n]a cretin like you can understand.
entries.uk: Пояснимо злиття так, що зрозуміє[n]навіть такий кретин, як ти.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Now then, fusion is a ritual by which[n]you kill your old self in order to give[n]birth to a new one...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Basically, you're gonna execute multiple[n]Personas to make a brand new Persona[n]with their blood.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Each Persona belongs to an arcana,[n]which in turn governs both how they[n]can be combined and the end result.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: By the way, as you are executing[n]multiple to create one Persona,[n]your stock will decrease.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Please do not forget that.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Rejoice, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Thanks to our generosity, we've decided[n]to permit you to use the Persona[n]Compendium.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It's a wonderful tool that lets you[n]register and store the data of any[n]Persona you've obtained.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We can then summon registered[n]Personas for you as many times[n]as your heart desires.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, and you can overwrite the states of[n]registered Personas at any time. Don't[n]forget that.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, there is a requisite fee for use[n]of this service.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The stronger the Persona you wish to[n]summon, the higher the fee shall[n]become. Please keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Bow down to us, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: As a reward for your hard work, we've[n]decide to let you to use the solitary[n]confinement cell!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Putting a Persona in Lockdown there[n]lets you power it up without having to[n]actually fight with it!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, and your Persona'll grow more[n]the longer it stays in Lockdown!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, a Persona left in Lockdown[n]for too long will fade away into[n]nothingness.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: To help alleviate your worry, we shall[n]keep a record of how long your Persona[n]has been in Lockdown.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Furthermore, we will inform you if your[n]Persona in Lockdown is in danger of[n]disappearing.
